# Application schema 1 corpus

These are authored create inputs, not trusted snapshots. The filename selects
mode and expected outcome; `invalid-` cases reject. Use schema version 1,
workflow version 2, and `engineer` in the Plan role roster. Questions require
trusted permission; research-question also rejects with permission disabled.

Implement completion uses US-001 at SHA256("frozen US-001"), snapshot-1 at
SHA256("retained implementation"), and check-1 retained for exactly that story,
revision and snapshot with executed=true, passed=true. These deterministic
synthetic evidence facts test validation, not authentic agent execution.
Validate completion deliberately reports complete unverified findings with no
retained snapshot; it establishes neither acceptance nor successful execution.
